title: Color Wheel MicroSim
subject: Mathematics
author: Dan McCreary
learningObjectives: Trace how the wheel() function maps a rotation position from 0 to 255 onto an RGB triple by ramping one channel up while another ramps down
Predict the RGB values produced at rotation positions 0, 85, and 170, which correspond to red, green, and blue
Explain why a 0 to 255 rotation range represents a full circle of hue that wraps back to its starting color
Identify complementary colors as the pair of positions on opposite sides of the wheel
Calculate the position of the rotation indicator line using the wheel center, radius, and rotation angle
